answer: Cosignatures are collected in lantern, verified in vertex, and cedar names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 8 submissions per epoch. That is 647 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
